title: STAPLE: Static Sparse Upcycling of Pretrained Checkpoints via Embedding Modules
abstract: arXiv:2610.12599v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sparse computation can scale the parametric capacity of LLMs without proportionally increasing active computation, but pretraining sparse architectures remains expensive and data-hungry. Existing sparse upcycling methods mainly target Mixture-of-Experts models, where expert homogeneity, sample inefficiency, and system overheads can limit practical scalability. Static sparse memory offers predictable access and token-specific updates that can help address these challenges, but naively integrating it into pretrained computation yields poor returns. In this work, we introduce STAPLE, a recipe built upon STEM for integrating static sparse memory into pretrained models. Whereas STEM replaces FFN up-projections with token-indexed embeddings, STAPLE retains them and adds the embeddings as a residual pathway, preserving pretrained computation while learning complementary token-specific information in a scalable manner. translated_title: STAPLE：通过嵌入模块实现预训练检查点的静态稀疏升级
translated_abstract: 稀疏计算可以在不按比例增加活跃计算量的情况下扩展大语言模型的参数容量，但预训练稀疏架构仍然成本高昂且需要大量数据。现有的稀疏升级方法主要针对混合专家模型，其中专家同质性、样本效率低和系统开销等问题可能限制其实际可扩展性。静态稀疏内存提供了可预测的访问方式和针对特定 token 的更新，有助于应对这些挑战，但将其简单地集成到预训练计算中收益甚微。在这项工作中，我们提出了 STAPLE，一种建立在 STEM 基础之上、用于将静态稀疏内存集成到预训练模型中的方法。STEM 用基于 token 索引的嵌入替换 FFN 上投影，而 STAPLE 则保留原有的 FFN 上投影，并将这些嵌入作为残差路径加入，在以可扩展的方式学习互补的 token 特定信息的同时，保留了预训练的计算能力。在 OLMo-2 1B 模型上，STAPLE 提升了……（摘要内容在此处截断）
tldr: STAPLE 通过将基于 token 索引的嵌入作为残差路径加入预训练模型，在保留原有 FFN 计算的同时以可扩展的方式学习互补的 token 特定信息，从而实现高效的静态稀疏升级。
en_tdlr: STAPLE integrates static sparse memory into pretrained models by adding token-indexed embeddings as a residual pathway, preserving pretrained FFN computation while scalably learning complementary token-specific information.
